title: Fréchet derivative of a primary matrix function as Loewner first divided differences
expression_sketch:
Let A = Z*diag(lam_1,...,lam_n)*Z**(-1) in C**(n,n) be diagonalizable and let f be C^1 on an open set containing {lam_i}. The Fréchet derivative of the primary matrix function at A in direction E is
  L_f(A, E) = Z * (F o (Z**(-1)*E*Z)) * Z**(-1),
where o is the Hadamard product and F is the Loewner matrix of first divided differences of the scalar germ f:
  F_ij = (f(lam_i) - f(lam_j))/(lam_i - lam_j)  if lam_i != lam_j,
  F_ii = f'(lam_i).
Two-node scalar members (SymPy-checkable):
  (f(x) - f(y))/(x - y)     for x != y,
  f'(x)                     at a repeated node.
Specialization f(z) = 1/z on invertible A (0 not in spec(A)):
  F_ij = -1/(lam_i*lam_j),
  L_{inv}(A, E) = -A**(-1)*E*A**(-1).
Specialization f(z) = exp(z) (entire; no spectral restriction):
  F_ij = (exp(lam_i) - exp(lam_j))/(lam_i - lam_j),
  F_ii = exp(lam_i).
2x2 diagonal probe: A = diag(x, y), E = [[e00, e01], [e10, e11]] gives off-diagonal L_01 = e01*(exp(x)-exp(y))/(x-y) for x != y, and e01*exp(x) when x = y.
latent_structure: Hidden Newton divided difference of a scalar germ f, with the diagonal of the Loewner table equal to the confluent (Hermite) node f'(lam_i). The matrix Fréchet derivative is not a new function: it is the Hadamard action of that table in an eigenbasis. Master object F is the scalar f; operators are Newton DD (distinct eigenvalues) and Hermite DD (repeated eigenvalues), then a similarity/Hadamard reconstruction. Autodiff of expm/logm/inv/sqrtm in scientific ML is this table, not a numerical fit.

branch_conventions: Primary matrix function via interpolation/Jordan calculus (Higham 2008 Ch. 1); not an entrywise scalar map.
For a future log specialization, use the principal logarithm with spec(A) in C minus (-oo, 0]; that specialization is not required for the exp/inv members.

why_not_cse_lgg: CSE can share f(lam_i) leaves but will not invent a Loewner table or identify off-diagonal difference quotients with the diagonal derivative as one divided-difference object. LGG anti-unifies first-order syntax; it does not emit Newton/Hermite nodes, Hadamard reconstruction, or the eigenbasis intertwiner. The compact object is L_f(A,E) = Ad_Z (F o Ad_{Z^{-1}} E), which is a representation change, not common-subexpression elimination.
proposer_leak_risk: Hide: Daleckii-Krein, Loewner, divided difference, Hermite, Fréchet, primary matrix function. Show only expanded component formulae in an eigenbasis (difference quotients plus diagonal f') and the inverse/exp specializations as separate catalog members. Do not print gold names or the reconstruction L_f = Z (F o ...) Z^{-1} in proposer-visible context.
notes: SciML role: reverse-mode sensitivity of expm/logm/inv/sqrtm. Catalog sketch: G0001 = (f(x)-f(y))/(x-y); G0002 = f'(x); G0003 = -A**(-1)*E*A**(-1); G0004 = 2x2 diagonal exp off-diagonal. F(z)=f(z). Operators: newton_dd at {x,y}; hermite_dd at {x,x}. Reconstruction: Loewner Hadamard in eigenbasis. SymPy: (1/lam-1/mu)/(lam-mu) + 1/(lam*mu) == 0. Not a numerical Jacobian fit.
